title: Rhidian Yiou
subtitle: A retro pixel art top-down RPG.
description: Retro pixel art top-down RPG with attacks, spells and a world with dynamic events.
synopsis: Rhidian You takes you on a classic fantasy RPG adventure set in an era of kings, magic and dark creatures. Explore a world full of secrets, traps and twisted realities.

roles.title: Lead Programmer
roles.description: I implemented systems from scratch, designing the architecture and developing it through to the polishing phase.

systems.title: Grid-based movement system
summary: The player moves cell by cell if there is no collision
Movement is locked until the current movement is completed
Input system prioritizing the last received input
systems.description: System that moves the character across the world grid, giving the developer more control over where the player can access. It also processes player input by always prioritizing the latest input to determine movement.

systems.title: Modular dialogue system
summary: ScriptableObjects for dialogue definition and MonoBehaviour for runtime
systems.description: Modular dialogue system based on ScriptableObjects that enables interactive conversations with branching paths based on player decisions. It includes support for section-based events and is centralized through a manager controlling UI and input.

systems.title: Inventory and equipment system
summary: Different item types: world, combat or hybrid
Equipment with gameplay stats (weapon, armor, shield and passive items)
Separation of responsibilities using different ScriptableObject types
systems.description: Inventory system managing combat, world and mixed items. It includes an equipment system with weapons, armor and shields that modify player stats. It also supports passive items that affect the character while in the inventory.

systems.title: Turn-based RPG combat system
summary: Turn-based combat inspired by classic RPGs
HP, MP and stats management such as strength, defense and agility
Simple system designed to be modular, scalable and extensible
systems.description: Turn-based RPG combat system similar to Dragon Quest, featuring HP, MP and basic stats like strength, defense and agility. Although simple, it is structured to allow easy expansion of mechanics, skills and more complex behaviors in the future.

systems.title: First-person exploration system
summary: Switch to retro first-person view mode
Maze-like tunnel exploration with directional navigation
Route validation system penalizing incorrect turns
systems.description: System that allows switching to a retro-style first-person view inspired by classics like Doom. The player explores maze-structured tunnels where navigation depends on directional choices. Incorrect turns result in being pushed out of the correct path, reinforcing exploration based on orientation and memory.

systems.title: Random encounter system
summary: Enemy spawns based on zones and conditions
systems.description: World enemy generation system defining which creatures can appear in each zone. It works through tilemap-painted cells that control spawn probability, sections and available enemies, allowing controlled and simple difficulty progression.

systems.title: Interaction system
summary: Reusable system for different interaction types
Execution of specific logic depending on entity type
Interaction with NPCs and world objects
systems.description: Centralized interaction system allowing the player to interact with NPCs and environmental elements such as shops, rest points and other interactive objects. Each interaction executes specific logic based on entity type through an interface.

systems.title: Global state flags system
summary: Key-based system (strings) to control world events
Event activation and deactivation based on player progress
systems.description: Key-based flag system storing world state and activating or deactivating events depending on player progress. These keys control event spawning, environment changes and narrative progression dynamically and flexibly.

systems.title: Save system
summary: Player state persistence in JSON format
Static runtime player state for easy access
Separation between game data and serializable structure
systems.description: JSON-based save system persisting full player state. Data is stored in a static class (PlayerState) for easy runtime access. When saving, this data is transferred into a dedicated serializable structure (SavedValues), ensuring separation between gameplay logic and persistence layer.

systems.title: Debug tools system
summary: Internal tools to modify game state in real time
Full control of player stats, inventory and events
Flag activation and system testing without gameplay flow
systems.description: Unity-integrated debug tool system allowing real-time modification of almost any game aspect, including player stats, inventory and event triggers. Designed to speed up testing and validate features without full gameplay flow.

systems.title: On-screen keyboard system
summary: Retro-style on-screen keyboard for name input
Navigation and input controlled via selection system
UI adapted to the game’s visual style
systems.description: On-screen keyboard system allowing players to enter their name in-game. It implements a retro-style interface controlled via input selection, adapted to the project’s visual style to maintain consistency.

learn: Development of designer tools based on Tilemaps to streamline level creation, along with systems that read this data to generate content and events automatically.
Implementation of a centralized input system using Unity's Input System through a Singleton pattern, avoiding PlayerInput to maintain greater control and flexibility in input management.
improvements: I would rethink the development order of the systems, giving higher priority to the dialogue system, as it is the main axis through which actions are communicated to the player. This would allow for better integration and greater scalability of the system.

title: FranForge API REST
subtitle: A simple REST API for web interactions.
description: REST API that acts as a messaging bridge between the user and the developer through the web.
synopsis: REST API hosted on Render that enables interaction between the user and the developer through the web service.
genre-and-tags: REST API, C#, .NET Core, Web Service.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
roles.description: Developed the backend using .NET Core and the frontend with JavaScript.

systems.title: REST API communication
summary: Separation of concerns with controllers, services, and models
systems.description: Core REST API system that manages communication between the web client and the developer through structured HTTP endpoints.

systems.title: Telegram bot integration
summary: Automatic message sending to Telegram after using the contact form or newsletter subscription
systems.description: Integration system with a Telegram bot that allows receiving and managing user messages in real time.

systems.title: Newsletter subscription
systems.description: System responsible for managing user subscriptions to a newsletter, storing and validating data in the database.

systems.title: MongoDB persistence
systems.description: Persistence layer using MongoDB to store user messages and newsletter subscriptions.

learn: Learned to use .NET Core for building REST APIs.
Used Swagger for the first time for localhost testing.
Built a Telegram bot that handles custom scenarios.
improvements: Would scale the Telegram bot to visualize data similarly to Swagger.
Would migrate the MongoDB database to SQL.

title: Magictory
subtitle: A medieval automation and arcane magic game.
description: Automation and resource management game in a 3D medieval world, where your goal is to rebuild a corrupted land through machinery.
synopsis: In a world consumed by dark beings, the king sends you, a simple trusted mage capable of shaping magic to make things work. This is where your adventure begins, building a settlement capable of housing magical protections so the people can live freely.
genre-and-tags: Automation, resource management, crafting, base building, construction.

roles.title: Solo Developer
roles.description: I developed the entire project alone. Design, programming, modeling and animations.

systems.title: Inventory and items
summary: ScriptableObjects to define resource types and reduce memory usage
Structs instead of classes and arrays instead of lists to reduce GC
Crafting system based on resource recipes
systems.description: Full system based on ScriptableObjects defining each resource type. A stack struct holds the resource reference and quantity. The inventory stores an array of stacks with a maximum capacity defined in Unity.

systems.title: Interaction system
systems.description: Interaction system based on interfaces implemented by every interactable object. Each object handles its own logic while player movement is blocked during interaction for consistency.

systems.title: Construction system
summary: Dedicated ActionMap for precise building control
systems.description: Construction system using a dedicated ActionMap allowing free camera and cursor control. Structures are defined via ScriptableObjects and unlocked progressively. Before placement, each structure validates material and space requirements.

systems.title: Custom tick system
summary: Periodic ticks using IEnumerators and Coroutines
Strict separation between logic and visuals
systems.description: TickManager executing logic periodically for all ITickable objects using coroutines, reducing reliance on Update for frequent calculations.

systems.title: World chunking system
summary: Loading/unloading zones based on player distance
systems.description: World divided into chunks that load or unload based on player distance, reducing resource usage by disabling irrelevant areas.

systems.title: Level of detail (LOD)
summary: Multiple levels of detail for performance optimization
systems.description: Implemented multiple LOD levels to maintain stable performance in complex environments.

systems.title: Character movement (NavMesh)
systems.description: Top-down movement system using NavMesh pathfinding with cursor. Also includes controller movement support for different platforms.

learn: Implementation of different optimization techniques, such as call centralization, use of LODs, chunk division, and the use of structs to reduce heap allocation (GC alloc).

Modular UI system for different types of panels, reused to manage inventory, crafting, upgrades, construction, and options, allowing similar behaviors with differentiated structures depending on the context.
Management of different Action Maps with Unity's Input System, adapting controls according to the game context.

Development of a connection system between structures based on connection points, where elements like belts and containers are capable of detecting adjacent structures and reacting to them dynamically.
improvements: I would migrate the main system architecture toward an approach based on Unity DOTS (Jobs System and Burst Compiler) to improve performance when processing large volumes of data.
I would simplify the game architecture by eliminating systems unnecessary for the final design, such as player movement, focusing it solely on a more polished construction system.

title: The Sky Project
subtitle: A 2D metroidvania, monster collector and turn-based RPG.
description: Classic turn-based RPG with a complex creature system including attacks, types, status effects and more.
synopsis: In a world divided by four planes where mana flows like rivers of power between worlds, a story of love, loss and discovery emerges. A celestial being from a seemingly perfect world embarks on a journey that will challenge everything it knows.
genre-and-tags: Monster Collector, Turn-based RPG, 2D platformer, Local multiplayer.

roles.title: Team Lead Programmer
roles.description: Managed the programming team during development.

roles.title: Game Core Systems Programmer
roles.description: Developed core gameplay mechanics and systems.

systems.title: Creature system
summary: Level progression with experience and attribute growth
systems.description: Creature system allowing complex entities with base stats, level growth and experience configuration. Includes an evolution system where each creature defines how attributes grow and which skills are learned at each level.

systems.title: Advanced combat system
summary: Turn-based combat with single and multi-target selection
Type system with effectiveness and weaknesses
Global energy per turn limiting skill usage
Status effects and usable items during combat
systems.description: Turn-based combat with advanced target selection, allowing single or area attacks. Includes type effectiveness system, global energy per turn limiting skill usage, random extra attacks per turn, and item usage with status effects.

systems.title: Parametrizable combat AI system
summary: Target priority system (health, level, damage, etc.)
Control over skill usage like healing and shields
Adaptable AI without modifying base logic
systems.description: Fully configurable enemy AI system allowing behavior definition without changing base logic, including targeting priorities and skill usage rules.

systems.title: 2D platform movement system
summary: Horizontal movement with air and ground control
Double jump and dash with cooldown
systems.description: Platform movement system with precise control, including jump, double jump, dash and gliding for fluid movement.

systems.title: Wild creature system
systems.description: Wild creature spawning system defining zone-based encounters with configurable probability and level ranges.

systems.title: Creature capture and management system
summary: Integration with progression and stats system
systems.description: System allowing capture of creatures during combat and adding them to player control with customization and progression integration.

systems.title: Global state flags system
systems.description: Same key-based flag system controlling world events and narrative progression dynamically.

systems.title: Binary save system
summary: Player state persistence in binary format
systems.description: Binary save system for optimized loading and saving, with manual serialization and debug integration.

systems.title: Debug tools system
summary: Full control over stats, inventory and events
systems.description: Debug system allowing real-time modification of game state for testing purposes.

learn: Data-driven architecture management using ScriptableObjects in Unity, structuring and linking creature, type, and attack data for the RPG system.
Parametrization of AI systems to adapt behaviors to different game scenarios.
Development of highly modular code to adapt to frequent changes in requirements and design tests during development.
improvements: I would reduce design complexity by eliminating systems that do not reinforce the core gameplay, such as deck building, to maintain a more coherent game identity.

title: Animal Strikers
subtitle: A casual 2D sports game with local multiplayer.
description: Arcade-style soccer game with chibi-style characters who use abilities to change the outcome of the match.
synopsis: In Animal Strikers, you put your soccer skills to the test using small characters with incredible abilities to win matches like a true legend. Play solo or with friends on the same device.

roles.title: Lead Programmer
roles.description: I implemented systems from scratch, designing the architecture and developing them through to the polishing phase.

systems.title: Character movement and control system
summary: AI using the same movement rules
systems.description: Arcade control system for soccer characters with contextual actions depending on the state: ground shot or aerial header. Designed to interact directly with ball physics.

systems.title: Game loop system
systems.description: Core system that manages scoring, resets after goals, and match duration.

systems.title: Abilities system
summary: Abilities that can be activated during the match
Effects such as freezing, changing ball size or speed
systems.description: Active abilities system that modifies gameplay conditions in real time, adding strategy and variability.

systems.title: Random events system
summary: Random events at the end of the match
systems.description: Event system that applies global effects to both players after the match.

systems.title: Narrative progression system by levels
summary: Level unlocks based on goal difference
systems.description: Progression system that unlocks levels based on player performance, including secret content.

systems.title: Skins and stats system
systems.description: Customization system with modular skins that affect both appearance and stats.

systems.title: Local multiplayer system
summary: Up to 2 players on the same device
systems.description: Local multiplayer system for two players with pre-match configuration.

systems.title: Binary save system
summary: Designed for platforms like Nintendo Switch
systems.description: Optimized binary save system for performance and platform compatibility.

learn: Experience in porting the project to Nintendo Switch, adapting systems and gameplay flow.
Implementation of a modular skin system tied to stats that affect gameplay.
In-depth work on local multiplayer managing multiple players on the same device.
improvements: I would expand the content by adding more abilities and options to improve replayability.

title: Luminaria: Dark Echoes
subtitle: A 2D casual game
description: 2D survivor with story where defeating enemies and unlocking abilities drives progression.
synopsis: You are the hero who must save the world from darkness. This action roguelike offers a steampunk story, bosses and exploration full of mysteries and surprises.

roles.title: Team Lead Programmer
roles.description: Managed the programming team during development.

systems.title: Skill unlock and progression system
summary: Random skill selection on level up
Active and passive skill slots system
systems.description: Skill progression system based on random selection during gameplay with limited slots for active and passive skills.

systems.title: Enemy behavior system
summary: Simple, ranged, charge and suicide AI
systems.description: Enemy system with varied behaviors including melee, ranged and environmental interaction.

systems.title: Boss system
systems.description: Boss system with modular attacks and UI presentation.

systems.title: Object pooling system
systems.description: Object pooling system improving performance by reusing objects.

systems.title: Local multiplayer system
systems.description: Local multiplayer system with shared progression and scaling difficulty.

systems.title: Persistent progression system
systems.description: Persistent progression system allowing upgrades between runs.

systems.title: Save system (.sav)
systems.description: Save system using .sav files for debugging and testing purposes.

systems.title: Additional features
systems.description: Support systems enhancing player experience.

learn: Experience in the simultaneous management of a large number of on-screen entities, specifically in a survivor-like game, optimizing their behavior and updates.
First experience using ScriptableObjects for data management and design control, enabling a more flexible and data-oriented architecture.
First implementation of Unity's Input System, including local multiplayer support, learning to coordinate and extract inputs from multiple players within the same system.
Deepened integration of the input system with game logic, specifically synchronization between controls and gameplay in a local multiplayer environment.
First project completed from start to finish, gaining experience in the entire development cycle, from implementation to final delivery and closure.
improvements: I would eliminate unnecessary systems that slowed down development and project closure, affecting the iteration pace.
I would design a more modular architecture from the early stages of development to allow for faster iterations and testing.
I would reduce the number of modes and levels to center the experience on the core gameplay, avoiding design dispersion and improving the game's focus.

title: Confinio Reality Prison
subtitle: A 2D casual game
description: Visual novel in 2D where you progress through narrative minigames that determine your future.
synopsis: Enter Confinio: Reality Prison, a visual novel where darkness surrounds your past and uncertainty guides your steps. Wake up in a cell with no memory where your decisions shape your fate.

roles.title: Minigames programmer
roles.description: Developed the minigames for the visual novel.

systems.title: Minigame loading system in Naninovel
summary: Integration of minigames into Naninovel framework
Communication between narrative and gameplay systems
systems.description: System that integrates minigames inside Naninovel, bridging narrative and gameplay.

systems.title: Minigames integrated into visual novel
summary: Rhythm minigame based on music timing
Puzzle minigame with clocks and object placement
Simplified RPG minigame with stats and abilities
systems.description: Multiple minigames embedded into the visual novel experience.

learn: Experimented with different architectural approaches adapted to each minigame, adjusting the structure according to their specific needs.
improvements: I would dedicate more time to pre-planning minigames, better defining their design before implementation to improve consistency and the quality of the final result.

title: Mechanic Party
subtitle: A 3D cooperative casual game
description: Play as a mechanic completing vehicle repair orders in the shortest time possible while finishing as many jobs as you can.
synopsis: Experience a group of mechanics trying to build their dream workshop by traveling across festivals, earning recognition and progress toward their destiny.

roles.title: Solo Developer
roles.description: I developed the entire project alone. Design, programming, modeling and animations.

systems.title: Task and delivery system
summary: Validation of complete or incomplete delivery
Score system based on delivery quality
systems.description: Task system managing vehicle repair workflow and scoring.

systems.title: 3D movement system with layered animation
systems.description: 3D movement system using Character Controller with layered animations.

systems.title: Interaction and object grabbing system
systems.description: Interaction system allowing pickup and manipulation of objects.

systems.title: Level progression and scoring system
systems.description: Progression system based on performance and stars.

systems.title: Local multiplayer system
systems.description: Local multiplayer system for shared-device play.

learn: Learned to work with inheritance and interfaces, applying SOLID principles within project constraints to structure more scalable and sustainable systems.
Deepened management of the Input System in a local multiplayer environment, controlling the assignment and synchronization of inputs among different players.
Learned to manage 3D mesh animations using layers, allowing for the modular separation and combination of different behaviors.
Implementation of custom shaders using Shader Graph to expand the project's visual and stylistic control.
improvements: I would improve the initial development process by conducting more rapid testing before full production, thus avoiding design issues and accumulated bugs.
I would incorporate Cinemachine to improve camera management and reduce the complexity of the tracking and visual control system.
I would develop faster and more efficient level creation tools to improve iteration and allow closing the gameplay loop earlier in development.

title: Neon Space
subtitle: A 3D arcade and casual game
description: A 3D endless runner where you pilot a spaceship that must dodge cubes to survive.
synopsis: Your mission is to survive as long as possible aboard this spaceship without colliding with cubes, while collecting temporary upgrades to increase your survival rate.

roles.title: Solo Developer
roles.description: I developed the entire project on my own: design, programming, and modeling.

systems.title: Ship movement
summary: The ship teleports to the position tapped by the player on the screen.
systems.description: The ship teleports left or right depending on where the player taps on the screen.

systems.title: Dynamic obstacles
summary: Colliding with them ends the game.
Speed increases as the game progresses.
systems.description: System that spawns obstacles in front of the ship, which are destroyed at the end of each lane.

systems.title: Power-ups
summary: Random power-ups appear on the map.
systems.description: To add more depth to the game, power-ups were included that slightly modify the gameplay rules.

learn: I learned to use C# more deeply instead of Unity’s node-based programming (Bolt).
improvements: I would replace the main system with a more stable approach, since the project relied on increasing Time.scale to speed up the cubes.
